subject: [PATCH v5 3/7] sched/numa: scan read-only file mappings in tiering mode

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) balancing code to scan read-only file mappings when tiering is enabled, but only performs promotion scans on these mappings. This change prevents hot file folios from being placed on slow memory in tiering mode, which can cause east-west placement bouncing. The patch also updates the walk type for each VMA (Virtual Memory Area) based on the balancing-mode snapshot taken in task_numa_work().
